contentHtml:
I set up and configure Plex and other media servers so your movies, TV shows, music, photos and home videos stream to every device you own, at home or away. Installation, library organisation, remote access and network tuning, handled end to end, for people around Stretton and Brisbane.

Your own private streaming library

Plex takes your personal collection, films, shows, music, family photos and home videos, and lays it out like a streaming service, with posters, descriptions and cast details pulled in automatically. It then streams the lot to the app on your smart TV, phone, tablet, computer or console. It is the perfect home for a lifetime of ripped DVDs, digital purchases, camcorder footage and photo archives that are currently scattered across drives and gathering dust.

What I set up

  • Server install on a PC, Mac, NAS or an NVIDIA Shield, whichever suits your setup and budget.
  • Library organisation done properly, so everything is named, matched and easy to browse.
  • Remote access, so you can watch your own library away from home.
  • Buffering and transcoding fixes, so it plays smoothly on every screen instead of stalling.

A media server works best on a NAS, which gives you the storage and reliability for a growing collection, and it pairs neatly with a proper smart TV and streaming setup in the lounge.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
